title: ID0483468-DC/Si-D/PL-[Y2/T04002921464] Polish Language Selection Failure
description:
Reported behavior/Issue: Polish Language Selection Failure
Solution: First language in SCB is the default - in this case was EN but should be PL

additional_info.subject: ID0483468-DC/Si-D/PL-[Y2/T04002921464] Polish Language Selection Failure CRM:03097000503
additional_info.body:
Hi Poland  Team,
I hope this email finds you well.
Thank you for all the information shared with us.
Checking the charger on our side I could see that we already have the last version of the firmware, and I could confirm that we also have the languages selected in SCB.
So to troubleshoot the situation I removed all the languages, did a soft reboot and added them back before a second soft reboot.
Can I ask you to confirm if it's possible to select Polish in the charger please?
With
best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
